note: Bon Homme County's zoning ordinance (adopted 1999, amended 2003 and 2015) refers to an Official Zoning Map, but no queryable ArcGIS service of zoning districts was found. The county GIS viewer (ims.districtiii.org/BON_HOMME, now gis.districtiii.org) has moved and its ArcGIS REST root returns 404; no zoning layer was discoverable through ArcGIS Hub/Online or web search. Springfield, Tyndall, Scotland, Tabor and Avon publish no zoning GIS found in search either.
